narrative.overview: An experimental opening-title sequence collides with an engineering production notebook. Real scanned stock carries physical material while semantic type, evidence, diagrams, and interaction remain crisp.
keyCharacteristics: Full process colors own complete scenes.
Compressed title lettering meets calm narrative copy.
Hard cuts, contact frames, and torn planes replace generic cards.
Motion is concentrated in one flight and the contribution exposures.

rules.name: The Whole-Pass Rule
rules.body: A process color owns a plane or scene; it is not scattered as decoration.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Condensed type directs, Clash explains, and monospace records.

rules.name: The Physical-Layer Rule
rules.body: Depth must describe stacked paper or ink registration.

dos: Do let full color fields create the scroll rhythm.
Do make evidence visible through real numbers, dates, access, and methodology.
Do keep mobile a newly composed sequence.
donts: Don't turn project one-sheets into a repeated card grid.
Don't use glass, smooth gradients, rounded floating surfaces, or conventional portfolio minimalism.
Don't use concept comps as production backgrounds.
